semantic_statement: Step 11b ladder is a feature-family ladder.
Step 11b is not a temporal cutoff ladder.
All week1-week3 behavior, day0-20, is available at day21 scoring.
is_only_w1 is not timing leakage under the day21 contract because week2-week3 are already observed.
is_w1_over_50pct is not timing leakage under the day21 contract because week1-week3 totals are already observed.
is_only_w1 and is_w1_over_50pct should not be called pure activation.
L1 AUC must not be interpreted as week1-only predictive power.
L1 AUC may be interpreted as early activation and front-loaded or early-only behavior family signal.
